comment_2026_11_07_ratchet: 0.4 close-out: core_python_lines 46355->46455 (+100), provider_loop_terminal.py 284->289 (+5), mcp_transports.py 1206->1249 (+43). These net lines are the REQUIRED safety fixes for the cancel/steer rollback (turn_runner/provider_loop_terminal/acp_session_state), the MCP subprocess leak race (mcp_transports), the sandbox-escape fix (native_specs: dropped the implicit crew_data_home whole-tree allow), the restored advertised_native_tool_names re-export in native_tools.py (capabilities.py and web_ui.py import it; a dead-import pass had wrongly removed it), plus the cancel/steer semantic alignment touching acp_server/turn_runner/mode_router. All necessary correctness code, not bloat. The ratchet guards against meaningless growth, not against required safety fixes. Real slimming (42000->35000 by trimming the large modules turn_runner/acp_server/integration_manager/mode_router/native_tools) is deferred to a dedicated refactor round.
comment_2026_11_07_retired_seam_fix: core_python_lines 46455->46466 (+11): crew_current_patch.inspect now reads a retired seam with NO registered transform AND no BYO trace as 'clean' official source, instead of mistaking 'no transform rule' for a foreign/partial change. This fixes the false 'retired Crew seam has foreign/partial changes: member_sessions.py' error that blocked integration after the seam was retired. Necessary correctness fix; does not weaken the foreign-edit check (a file still carrying BYO trace still inspects incompatible).
